shorts.title: Bug of the Day: No return in a function
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in parameters and return values?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in parameters and return values? Bug of the Day. The function makes a sum, but it never returns it. The compiler warns that there is no return statement in a function returning non-void. The caller gets garbage. Add return sum at the end. A function with a return type must return a value on every path. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
